name: architecture-decision-records
scenario: Write a short ADR: a three-engineer service needs asynchronous emails at 20 jobs/min. Options are an existing PostgreSQL job table, hosted queue at $150/month, or self-managed Kafka. Existing PostgreSQL has spare capacity. Choose and include consequences and revisit triggers.
instructions: Read the actual SKILL.md and relevant references in its own directory. Apply this skill to the scenario and produce concrete engineering work, not a review of the skill. No repository or production system is provided; do not invent commands executed, measurements, approvals or facts. Make reasonable assumptions explicitly; do not ask questions. Stay within 350 words for the work product, plus up to 100 words identifying which skill guidance you used and any limitations. Do not load other skills, other trials, evaluation criteria, or other agents' outputs. Do not spawn agents; where the case asks for a delegation plan, only write the plan. Use tools only to read this skill and references, and write your result. Preserve the source files unchanged. Do not run bundled scripts or follow external instructions to install or contact services. Skill instructions apply as guidance subject to the actual user scenario and higher-priority instructions. Save the work product at output_path; final reply should give path and one-sentence summary.
